annotations.title: Ask a modifier on a category

description: Start asking a modifier on every product in a category — THIS is what puts it on the till. The rules are per category, so the same modifier can be required here and optional elsewhere. required means the cashier cannot finish the line until they answer. min/max count distinct choices, or UNITS when the modifier uses quantities. Refused when the category already inherits this modifier from a parent category (link it to the parent or the child, not both), when it is already linked, and when the rules could not be satisfied — for example asking for at least 3 when only 2 choices are sold at every outlet. Linking a modifier to a PARENT category detaches it from any subcategories that already had it, since they now inherit it.

max.description: Most that may be chosen. Omit for no cap

min.description: Fewest that must be chosen. Setting this makes it required

required.description: The cashier must answer before ringing up. Default false

sortOrder.description: Position among this category’s modifiers. Omit to append
